note: Hand-written developer questions over npm/cli v10.9.0 first-party code, each with the function that answers it (path::name; the line number is matched at load time). Written after reading each function; phrased as a developer would ask, avoiding the function's own identifiers where natural.

queries.query: suggest the closest command when the user mistypes one
turn a number of bytes into a human readable size like 1.2 kB
work out the process exit code from an error object
retry the registry request with a one-time password when two-factor auth is required
stamp the node and npm versions into the manifest before it is published
walk up parent folders looking for a node_modules/.bin that contains the executable
decide which executable to run from a package's bin entries
skip binary files when printing the diff between two package versions
reject anything that is not an http or https link before opening it in the browser
prompt for a password without echoing it to the terminal
compare the lockfile versions with the resolved dependency tree and report mismatches
build the SPDX identifier for a package in the software bill of materials
tell the user how many installed packages are asking for donations
work out which dependency types to leave out from the production, include and omit flags
should this dependency be included in the security audit
check that a provenance attestation matches the package being published
print one dependency link with its version range for npm explain
is the package npx was asked to run already installed, or does it need fetching
normalise path separators and drop a leading ./ from file patterns
tab-complete folder names that contain a package.json for npm install
